commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Alex Freeman (Villarreal) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
88' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman signals a throw-in for Villarreal.
86' Thomas Lemar (Girona) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
86' Joel Roca (Girona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Girona are awarded a corner kick.
85' Joel Roca (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Azzedine Ounahi.
85' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hugo Rincon (Girona) replacing Arnau Martinez.
80' It's time for a substitution. Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) comes on in place of Alfonso Pedraza.
80' Fran Beltran (Girona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
77' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
76' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
74' Michel has decided to substitute Ivan Martin and he is replaced by Thomas Lemar (Girona).
74' Today's match ends for Daley Blind who will be replaced by Alejandro Frances (Girona).
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) coming on for Nicolas Pepe.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Moleiro leaves the pitch and Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal) comes on.
70' Here is a change. Santiago Mourino is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Alex Freeman (Villarreal).
70' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
66' The resulting corner, taken by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), comes to nothing.
66' A first-time shot by Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. Good work from Villarreal as they win a corner.
62' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Paulo Gazzaniga, who smothers the ball.
61' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
60' Axel Witsel (Girona) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. Girona will take a corner kick.
60' Girona take a short corner kick.

60' Abel Ruiz (Girona) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Luiz Junior, who tips the ball around the post. The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
59' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
58' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
57' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) sends the corner into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts it and averts the threat.
56' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
53' Vitor Reis (Girona) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
49' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes a short corner kick.
49' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
47' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' 1 - 0 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. Pau Navarro (Villarreal) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him, it's into his own goal!
45+1' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
44' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner.
43' Alex Moreno (Girona) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
42' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
41' Alex Moreno (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
40' Alex Moreno (Girona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
35' Alex Moreno (Girona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. It's a throw-in for Girona.
33' The ratio of the ball possession is 65:35.
29' Vitor Reis (Girona) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
29' Corner kick. Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
28' Abel Ruiz (Girona) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Girona have a corner.
25' Alex Moreno (Girona) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
24' Alex Moreno (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but Luiz Junior comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Axel Witsel (Girona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
21' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
20' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
18' Abel Ruiz (Girona) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
16' Girona are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Fran Beltran (Girona) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
12' Michel is forced to make a change. Vladyslav Vanat is unable to continue due to injury, Abel Ruiz (Girona) comes on.
11' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' The ball is cleared after Pape Gueye (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' Ivan Martin (Girona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
6' A quickly taken corner by Girona.

6' Fran Beltran (Girona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Girona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
4' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
4' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Villarreal earn a corner.
3' Ivan Martin (Girona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Luiz Junior is quickest to intercept the ball.
2' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Villarreal will take the kick-off.
